# PLAN — iteration 1
## Current state assessment

The incumbent uses 63 LUTs and 55 FFs, passes the supplied simulation, and has routed setup WNS of −1.2 ns with hold WHS of +0.066 ns. The reported worst path launches from the FIFO read pointer and reaches `out_data[7]` through distributed RAM, a LUT, and the output buffer; the top’s numeric latency is unknown, so no numeric top annotation is required. Timing closure is the first objective, and the FIFO’s registered-state outputs and cycle behavior must remain unchanged.

## Hypothesis

Registering the FIFO head byte and driving `out_data` directly from that register should remove the read-pointer-to-output mux path and improve setup timing, at the cost of up to 8 additional FFs.

## Instruction for generator

In `rx_fifo`, replace the `mem[rd_ptr]` combinational output selection with an `out_data` register that is zero after reset, loads `wr_data` on a push into an empty FIFO, and loads the next head byte on a pop when entries remain. Handle simultaneous pop/push at occupancy one by loading the incoming byte, and ensure a pop without a replacement produces zero; otherwise hold the registered head value. Preserve FIFO ordering, full replacement, overflow pulse, all parameter values, and the exact cycle in which each output changes. Keep the existing UART timing and counter behavior intact.
